errors.evidence: The description claims the line fluctuates between 1.00% and 2.50% after 2011. This is incorrect, as the line drops to a minimum of approximately -0.5% in 2015, which is well outside this range.
The description states the value for 2015 is 0.50%, but the chart clearly shows a negative value of approximately -0.5%.
